title: Keep matching rows
summary: T-SQL: Keep matching rows. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: WHERE keeps rows that pass a condition. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.

blocks.title: Keep matching rows
blocks.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (4), (8), (9)) AS scores(n) WHERE n >= 7 ORDER BY n;

blocks.text: WHERE removes 4 because it is below 7. ORDER BY keeps the remaining result in order.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: WHERE filters rows before they are grouped.
